name: Gesshoku
source: I only love "her," but she is searching for my "lies." We overlap, we clash, and I'm being consumed. I couldn't bring myself to ask, "Do you love me the most?" I only love "her," but she is searching for my "lies."
translation: 我只爱“她”，而她却在寻找我的“谎言”。我们重叠，我们冲突，而我正在被消耗。我不敢问自己：“你最爱我吗？”我只爱“她”，而她却在寻找我的“谎言”。
